# rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles (Resource)

Manages the full set of IAM operator roles (and the worker node instance role) required by a ROSA Seaplane V2 (HCP) cluster, for a given operator roles prefix and OIDC issuer. Role definitions and trust policies are resolved from the shared seaplane `iam` definition set, so no hand-written IAM JSON is needed.

On refresh the roles are reconciled against the resolved definition set: missing policies are attached, drifted trust policies and tags are repaired, and roles are tagged with the applied `definition_version`. Policies are only ever attached (never detached), so roles shared with running V1-managed clusters are never broken.

The resource talks directly to AWS IAM using the provider's ambient AWS credentials (the same credential chain as the AWS provider); it does not call the Platform API or OCM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aws_caller_identity" "current" {}

provider "rhcs" {
  seaplane_url   = var.seaplane_url
  aws_account_id = data.aws_caller_identity.current.account_id
  aws_caller_arn = data.aws_caller_identity.current.arn
  aws_region     = var.aws_region
}

resource "rhcs_seaplane_oidc_config" "oidc" {
  managed = true
}

# Creates the full V2 operator role set for the prefix, including the worker
# instance role and its EC2 instance profile. Trust policies are generated
# from the shared seaplane iam definitions — no hand-written IAM JSON.
resource "rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles" "roles" {
  operator_roles_prefix = "my-cluster"
  oidc_issuer_url       = rhcs_seaplane_oidc_config.oidc.issuer_url
}

variable "seaplane_url" {
  type        = string
  description = "Seaplane Platform API endpoint."
}

variable "aws_region" {
  type        = string
  description = "AWS region used to sign Seaplane Platform API requests."
}
```

## Import

Import an existing role set by its operator-roles prefix, e.g. one created by the rosa CLI:

```
terraform import rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles.roles my-cluster
```

Use the `rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles` [data source](../data-sources/seaplane_operator_roles.md) to discover an existing role set first.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oidc_issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL of the (managed or unmanaged) OIDC config the operator role trust policies are bound to, e.g. the `issuer_url` of a `rhcs_seaplane_oidc_config` resource. Must use an `https://` scheme.
- `operator_roles_prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to every operator role name (roles are named `<prefix>-<suffix>`). Changing this replaces the role set.

### Optional

- `permissions_boundary` (String) ARN of the permissions boundary attached to every operator role. Optional; changing it updates the boundary in place.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) AWS account ID hosting the operator roles.
- `definition_version` (String) Version of the seaplane `iam` definition set applied to the roles. Roles are tagged with this value for drift detection.
- `id` (String) The operator roles prefix (also used as the import key).
- `instance_profile_name` (String) Name of the worker node EC2 instance profile.
- `partition` (String) AWS partition the roles live in (`aws`, `aws-cn`, or `aws-us-gov`).
- `roles` (Attributes List) The resolved operator role set, in definition order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) IAM role ARN.
- `is_worker_role` (Boolean) True for the worker node instance role (EC2 trust).
- `managed_policy_arns` (List of String) AWS-managed policy ARNs attached to the role.
- `name` (String) Full IAM role name (`<prefix>-<suffix>`).
- `service_accounts` (List of String) OIDC trust subjects of the role. Empty for the worker role.
- `suffix` (String) Role name suffix from the definition set.
- `trust_policy` (String) The role's assume-role (trust) policy document.
